Streaming chat completion that produces no content chunks before the DONE signal

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
result = LiterLlm.chat_stream(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Say nothing', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4', stream: true)).to_a
puts result.inspect

```
